title: goop logo
brief: Logo for goop, a local job search agent TUI for developers: a fire with two eyes. Must work as a large mark, a 16 px favicon, on light and dark backgrounds, in monochrome and as text inside a terminal.

artboards.title: Geometric flame
artboards.tradeoff: Serious engineering look, crisp at 16 px; least friendly, eyes lose personality when small

artboards.title: Friendly mascot
artboards.tradeoff: Warm, memorable, matches the chat personality; gradient blurs below 32 px and may read as playful

artboards.title: Pixel flame
artboards.tradeoff: Identical in SVG, favicon and terminal blocks; can look retro on large surfaces

artboards.title: Pixel mascot
artboards.tradeoff: Mascot warmth, terminal-native from one pixel grid; fixed palette turns the gradient into color bands
